mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=1,1,null)) received, COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=2,1,null)) delivering, COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=3,1,null)) finished, COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=4,1,null)) dispute, COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=5,1,null)) complete, COUNT(IF(oi.order_status=6,1,null)) cancel FROM tb_rider_order ro INNER JOIN order_info oi ON ro.order_no = oi.order_no WHERE ro.rider_user_id = #{riderUserId} AND ro.is_deleted = 0 AND oi.is_deleted = 0
